tagline: Your Health Records. One Clear Picture.
disclaimer: Personal Health Copilot helps organize medical records and explain health information. It does not diagnose diseases, replace professional medical advice, or prescribe treatment. AI-generated explanations and extracted information may contain errors. Verify important findings with a qualified healthcare professional.

landing.badge: Hackathon Edition • AI Medical Record Intelligence
landing.heroDescription: Healthcare information is scattered across prescriptions, laboratory reports, and discharge summaries. Personal Health Copilot organizes your medical records into one unified, clear picture with plain-language explanations.
landing.step1Desc: Drag and drop PDF medical reports, lab results, prescriptions, or scanned documents securely.
landing.step2Desc: AI extracts structured lab values, flags results outside reference ranges, and translates jargon into plain explanations.
landing.step3Desc: Track lab value trends over time, maintain a chronological health timeline, and export standardized FHIR R4 records.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Built with medical accuracy, safety disclaimers, and user privacy at core.
landing.f1Desc: PyMuPDF text extraction & layout-aware OCR for scanned reports and PDFs.
landing.f2Desc: Google Gemini powered plain-language explanations with clear questions for your doctor.
landing.f3Desc: Interactive charts comparing historical lab values across dates with reference bounds.
landing.f4Desc: Searchable dropdown with 80+ living languages including Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, and Arabic.
landing.f5Desc: Standardized FHIR JSON resource export for Observations, Medications, and Patients.
landing.f6Desc: Explicit disclaimers, reference bound validation, and zero automated medication changes.
